node.title: Rank-eleven component mass concentrates on one nine-subset
node.closure: typed lane selection, exact subset deduplication, and uniform endpoint averaging
node.statement: One of the affine-owner and rank-deficient kernel component lanes carries at least 495405467 ppb of all record/eleven-subset incidences. Marking all nine-subsets and dividing by the exact C(m'-9,2) extension multiplicity gives one fixed nine-subset B carrying at least 2578110 distinct records in that same lane, uniformly for every 10<=K'<=1048576. This is a target concentrator, not a component identity or payment.
